papers.title: Pasty rule card
lines: A true pasty has a crimp on the side, not the top. Beef, potato, swede and onion. Never carrot.
The initial of the owner goes on one end, so they know which half to eat first.

papers.title: Miner's letter
lines: Dear Jenny, a hundred fathoms down the sea is over our heads. You can hear it, on a quiet day.
We call the knockers by name and leave them a bit of pasty crust. No accidents yet. Do not tell the mine captain.

papers.title: Scrap of paper
lines: Signal lamp: three flashes, wait, three flashes. Nobody is to light the beacon without a pilot.
In fainter ink, centuries earlier: 'If the ship strikes, all is lost. If it strikes in daylight, some is found.'

trail.clue: A wrecker's chest was said to be buried near the big rock. The note is signed with a scratched anchor.

papers.title: Surf school note
lines: Lesson one: standing up. Lesson two: standing up again.
Lesson three: the sea is large and you are small. Be kind to it.
